infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sai ki Family uses the photos and videos you select to add your profile picture or attach media to a community post, event or business listing. For example, you can share a photo from a Sai Mandir visit in an experience post.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Sai ki Family transcribes your speech when you choose a voice feature. For example, you can dictate an experience post or ask Ask Sai a question without typing.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sai ki Family uses your microphone when you choose to record an audio post or speak to Ask Sai. For example, record your Sai experience to share with the community.
